new_written_arguments: For EVERY polynomial H, the actual composite fibre is a disjoint union of primitive fibres; projection of the actual Haar lift gives specified physical primitive continuations on every branch.

After L turns with L divisible by root multiplicities e_a, tube naturality gives componentwise S_L(A)d_H=S_(L/e_a)(T_a)d_a. Other tubes bound discs in the selected primitive complement, so there is no hidden cross-branch cancellation or extra multiplicity factor.

Generalized eigenvalue-1 composite motion lies in the sum of primitive eigenvalue-1 full-return blocks. S_k(T) is invertible on a unipotent block. For EVERY eventually pure H(f), all-marker safety is therefore equivalent to all induced primitive projected variations vanishing, without primitive purity.

Those primitive projected variations vanish iff all ORIGINAL marked primitive Cauchy periods have no integer-exponent logarithms, by regular singularity and full de Rham detection, even if f is not pure.

If finite local monodromy on the actual Haar orbit span W_f is semisimple at 1, EVERY eventually pure polynomial composite is safe. Unique-centre reflection then completely classifies such composites as H(c)=0 for the unique safe centre, or none if no safe centre exists.
A finite original-unit jet separates purity from eventual purity uniformly over all degrees of H. Exact cyclic-block controls retain why eventual purity cannot be dropped.
essential_boundaries: BOTH complete exceptional MZ cases remain OPEN. The W_f hypothesis is NOT proved for all exceptional primitive factors.
No claim that f-a is pure or eventually pure; no reduction to pure primitive phases. Every polynomial composite remains covered by the exact branch test.
W_f is the actual full complement Haar monodromy orbit, not just fibre monodromy or an arbitrary fixed lift. All branches and induced physical continuations are retained.
No universal topology proof is machine verified, no general Betti producer or uniform unit/marker cutoff is computed, and no arbitrary coefficient-ring promotion is claimed.
The abstract cyclic-block countercontrol is not an actual exceptional phase. No degree/support/prefix campaign or external-review gate is introduced.
